texts.content:
From: Valley Auto Care
To: Robert Hughes
Subject: Service Appointment Confirmed

Hi Robert,
Your appointment is confirmed for Wednesday, April 2, at 8:00 A.M. at our Main Street location.

Vehicle: 2019 Honda Civic
Services: oil change, tire rotation, and brake check
Estimated time: about 2 hours

You are welcome to wait in our lounge, which has free Wi-Fi and coffee. If you'd prefer, our free shuttle can take you anywhere within three miles and pick you up when your car is ready.

If our technician finds any other problems, we will call you for approval before doing any extra work.

See you soon,
Valley Auto Care

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?
options: A. To advertise a discount on tires
B. To confirm the details of a car service visit
C. To report a problem with Robert's brakes
D. To offer Robert a new car
questions.explanation: The subject is "Service Appointment Confirmed," and the email lists the date, vehicle, and services.

questions.stem: What is one option offered to Robert while he waits?
options: C. A ride to a nearby place
questions.explanation: "Our free shuttle can take you anywhere within three miles and pick you up when your car is ready."

questions.stem: What will most likely happen if the technician finds a new problem?
options: A. The work will be done right away.
B. Robert will be asked to return on April 3.
C. The appointment will be canceled.
D. Robert will be contacted first.
questions.explanation: The shop says, "we will call you for approval before doing any extra work."
